name: Federal Reserve press releases RSS
why: High-impact FOMC, emergency facilities and policy communications move real-rate expectations, the US dollar and gold.

name: Federal Reserve speeches and testimony RSS
why: Policy tone shifts often appear first in speeches, testimonies and prepared remarks.

name: BLS CPI RSS
why: US inflation surprises reprice Fed expectations and real yields, which are core gold drivers.

name: BLS Employment Situation release page
why: Payrolls and unemployment data directly affect rate-path pricing, USD direction and gold sentiment.

name: BEA Personal Income and PCE page
why: PCE inflation and spending are core macro inputs for Fed pricing and therefore for gold.

name: CME FedWatch
why: Exchange-implied probability shifts are often a cleaner signal than headlines alone.
notes: JS-heavy page; best scraped via a dedicated adapter or manual summary.

name: CFTC Commitments of Traders
why: Managed-money and hedger positioning helps the swarm detect crowded gold trades and squeeze risk.

name: World Gold Council ETF holdings and flows
why: ETF flow data is one of the cleanest publicly available demand measures for gold.

name: World Gold Council trading volumes
why: Liquidity and turnover context help distinguish genuine regime shifts from thin-market noise.

name: World Gold Council central-bank reserves
why: Official-sector accumulation supports medium-term gold demand narratives and reserve-diversification themes.

name: LBMA daily trade reporting data
why: London bullion market turnover helps detect whether a move is backed by deeper spot-market participation.

name: Bank of England gold statistics
why: BoE custody holdings give another official-sector lens on bullion stock changes and vault demand.

name: MINING.com gold RSS
why: Useful for supply-side headlines, miners, M&A, disruptions and gold-market specific narrative color.

name: FRED API documentation
provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
why: Useful for adding structured real-rate, DXY, breakeven or financial-condition series to the context builder.
notes: Best used with preselected series IDs rather than raw endpoint discovery.
